coder_notes: Only treatment is a CAR T-cell product (excluded intervention type), so no candidate; S6 fails. IL13Ra2 and EGFR eligibility biomarkers are mechanistically linked to the CAR T targets but candidate_matched is false because the CAR T product is not a candidate agent. Exploratory objectives also plan pre/post evaluation of IL13Ra2 and EGFR alterations and CAR T persistence in tumour/CSF; tumour_pk_planned and target_engagement_planned coded no because they concern the non-candidate CAR T product. FDG is registered as a procedure (FDG-PET) and listed as diagnostic agent for transparency. IDH status is not an entry restriction (both IDH-wildtype GBM and IDH-mutant grade 4 astrocytoma eligible), so no IDH biomarker row. Tocilizumab and steroids are mentioned only in eligibility (contraindications), not registered interventions; not listed.
